items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: Mat was amazing, Rachel is amazing. I see her every year when we play at the Sun Coast Jazz Festival.

ctx.x: You had a couple of Arbors recordings which I was happy to hear about. And that’s a wonderful label and I’m so happy that they took an interest and you know Mat and — it was just a good service — speaking of service, they really provided a service for a lot of people. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

They — Mat was amazing, Rachel is amazing. I see her every year when we play at the Sun Coast Jazz Festival. And yeah, they were really, really great. I mean they did a lot of good for a lot of musicians and a lot of people. And yeah, those records I did for them were a great memory, especially the tribute to Benny that I did because I got to work with Dick Hyman and Bucky. I was fortunate, really fortunate to be kind of on that last wave to get to know these guys that were there for the original thing. And you…
So I have an idea for your shows. I think you should introduce the Mozart Clarinet Concerto and see how that goes over.
